notes.title: World of Rune version 1.1 Update on 2023/10/25
notes.content:
1. Adds Wonder (unlocked at Lv.80).
2. Adds the King's Chest and the King's Quest to the Joyful Celebration. Improves the rules for Hit the Bun and Slot.
3. Adds Zodiac (unlocked at Lv.80).
4. Increase in the number of targets that can be challenged in the Guild Boss.
5. Improves the rules of receiving the Last Hit Reward and the Kill Reward in the Battle of Throne. Please refer to the in-game description for more information.
6. Improves the notification display in the Altverse.
